title: Discount real estate agent
summary: Sell your home with low fees instead of commissions.
whyItFails: Sellers fear underpricing. They trust traditional agents. Agents fight back. Industry pressure. Low volume. Few transactions per customer.

attempts.notes: Flat-fee estate agent once valued over £1.3 billion; quit Australia and the US in 2019 as unprofitable.

attempts.outcome: Laid off most staff and closed its brokerage

reasons.detail: Sellers fear underpricing: They trust traditional agents.
Low volume: Few transactions per customer.
